name: 01_Lab_distributions_fresh
title: CIELAB distributions: fresh
caption: Within each scan, colour histograms are weighted by visible 3D surface area and normalised. Curves average scan histograms with one equal contribution per specimen. Assumed sRGB/D65/2°; these describe exported appearance. Background pixels are excluded.

name: 01_Lab_distributions_mature
title: CIELAB distributions: mature
caption: Within each scan, colour histograms are weighted by visible 3D surface area and normalised. Curves average scan histograms with one equal contribution per specimen. Assumed sRGB/D65/2°; these describe exported appearance. Background pixels are excluded.

name: 02_Lab_scan_centroids
title: Colour centroids by scanner and stage
caption: Each point is one scan's surface-area-weighted mean CIELAB colour. Colours identify scanners; symbols identify experimental stages. Separation is descriptive, not a classification result.

name: 03_paired_scanner_colour
title: Paired colour differences between scanners
caption: Each comparison matches the same physical specimen and experimental stage. Cells show median ΔE₀₀ between area-weighted scan mean Lab colours and the number of paired specimens. This is a centroid difference, not a pointwise ΔE map or a colour-accuracy measurement.

name: 04_paired_colour_stage_changes
title: Within-specimen colour changes across stages
caption: Thin lines follow individual physical specimens within each scanner; thick lines show medians. Colour change is measured relative to each specimen's own baseline scan. Fresh specimens have two stages; mature specimens have three. No plaque labels are inferred from stage names.

name: 05_mesh_sampling_fresh
title: Mesh sampling: fresh
caption: Dots represent individual scans; connected markers show scanner medians and vertical bars show the interquartile range. Vertex counts include encoded texture-seam duplicates; unique geometric vertices weld exact coordinate duplicates for counting only. Source meshes are not changed.

name: 06_surface_topography_fresh
title: Surface topography: fresh
caption: Plane-detrended topographic descriptors. Native RMS uses exact triangle-area integration; mean absolute height and height quantiles use deterministic uniform-area samples. Native slopes are area-weighted. These are scanner-derived, unfiltered descriptors, not independently validated standard roughness measurements. Dots are scans; markers/IQRs summarise specimens.

name: 07_common_scale_roughness_fresh
title: Roughness at shared physical scales: fresh
caption: Stored height maps are surface-area-weighted box-averaged into cells of the indicated physical width, then plane-detrended again. Lines show medians and shading the specimen IQR. Cells below the coverage threshold are excluded; holes are not filled. Equal grid spacing does not establish equal scanner resolution. No Gaussian or standardised roughness-band filtering is applied.

name: 05_mesh_sampling_mature
title: Mesh sampling: mature
caption: Dots represent individual scans; connected markers show scanner medians and vertical bars show the interquartile range. Vertex counts include encoded texture-seam duplicates; unique geometric vertices weld exact coordinate duplicates for counting only. Source meshes are not changed.

name: 06_surface_topography_mature
title: Surface topography: mature
caption: Plane-detrended topographic descriptors. Native RMS uses exact triangle-area integration; mean absolute height and height quantiles use deterministic uniform-area samples. Native slopes are area-weighted. These are scanner-derived, unfiltered descriptors, not independently validated standard roughness measurements. Dots are scans; markers/IQRs summarise specimens.

name: 07_common_scale_roughness_mature
title: Roughness at shared physical scales: mature
caption: Stored height maps are surface-area-weighted box-averaged into cells of the indicated physical width, then plane-detrended again. Lines show medians and shading the specimen IQR. name: 08_scanner_stage_response_fresh
title: Scanner-dependent stage changes: fresh
caption: All changes are paired within a physical specimen and scanner. Curves show scanner medians and dots show individual paired changes. Signed changes are later minus earlier; density ratios are later divided by earlier. Differences indicate stage associations, without identifying plaque pixels.

name: 08_scanner_stage_response_mature
title: Scanner-dependent stage changes: mature
caption: All changes are paired within a physical specimen and scanner. Curves show scanner medians and dots show individual paired changes. Signed changes are later minus earlier; density ratios are later divided by earlier. Differences indicate stage associations, without identifying plaque pixels.

name: 09_stage_montage_BCG1-4
title: Matched stage series: BCG1-4
caption: Original saved unlit RGB projections; columns are scanners and rows are experimental stages. Images share physical display limits. Scanner-specific canonical frames do not provide exact pointwise correspondence between scanners.

name: 10_colour_geometry_mesh_BCG1-4_baseline
title: Colour, geometry and native mesh: BCG1-4, baseline
caption: Matched scans of one specimen. Rows show saved RGB, neutral-shaded native geometry with a fixed 20× vertical exaggeration for display only, native triangle edges in a 4 mm square, and area-averaged/detrended height at 0.05 mm cells. The height colour limit is shared across all selected scans (±20.3 µm). Lighting and relief exaggeration are identical across scanners; quantitative measurements use unexaggerated geometry. These views illustrate appearance and structure without asserting plaque location.

name: 11_Lab_maps_BCG1-4_baseline
title: CIELAB maps: BCG1-4, baseline
caption: CIELAB channels derived from the saved RGB projection under assumed sRGB/D65/2°. Each channel uses identical display limits across scanners; limits for a* and b* are ±80 and may clip display extremes. All numeric summaries use the full, unclipped values.
